content_md: Micro Time seems to be the emerging regime of our present, but it is still hard to see for the lay person. It’s an “this is still early" situation though, so forcing urgency where there is none (yet) would be wrong. Making this development and its implications tangible is needed. How does Micro Time FEEL like?
